arguments.message:
No – the old key does not stop working the moment you create a new one. When you generate a new API key in Settings → Developer → API keys, both the new and the existing key remain valid until you explicitly revoke the old key. This overlap window lets you deploy the new key, verify that everything works, and only then revoke the old key from the same screen, ensuring no downtime.

You can also check the delivery and request logs (which are keyed by the API key) to confirm that the old key is no longer being used before you revoke it.
